title: Downhill Descent Racing (snowboarding browser game in threejs)
author: Limp-Caterpillar8661
selftext:
Hi! First post

A few weeks ago u/handlebarsdev posted a downhill biking game on indiegamedev

I was inspired to try to make my own, and make a downhill snowboarding game that uses Dance Dance Revolution / Helldivers II input for controls and combos.  

Still a very early attempt, but I’ve made enough improvements I’d love to get anyone else’s opinions or thoughts

Playable in the browser, or on mobile 

Lots of settings to control   
\- performance  
\- rider (on or off) (I like off, feels more like a tech deck snowboarding game)  
\- ghosts to race against  
\- leaderboard  
\- weather/ budget devices  
\- rider equipment that boosts stats

Game has two modes.   
\- A race mode (2-3 minutes of gameplay)  
\- free ride (infinite mountain exploration / generative repeats through seeded sections)

Thanks for your time!
